description: Seed enforcement is the existing body walk with the promise rules plugged in: an uncaught `throw` in an `async` body is a rejection of its own promise, and `return <expr>` folds what that expression would reject with into it — implicit arrow bodies included.

diagnostics.message: This `@nothrow` function returns a promise, so the mark covers its rejection too: the call that produced it has a body that was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: `await` it inside a `try`/`catch` and return a value instead, or make that producer non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
